labels.name: libopenssl3
labels.note: The key carries both a fixed range (3.1.4-150600.5.53.1, the released build) and a no-fix range (the same products' bare known_affected, see the at-released-build case); a build below the released one is judged on the fixed range and names it.

labels.name: libopenssl3
labels.note: SUSE released libopenssl3 3.1.4-150600.5.53.1 for SLES 15 SP6-LTSS and SAP 15 SP6 and still lists both products' bare package ids under known_affected (revision 29, 2026-10-21: 'more updates released, more updates marked as affected'; the CVE page shows 'In progress' beside the released build, bugzilla 1266344 IN_PROGRESS). The verdict at the released build is therefore affected with no complete fix recorded, mirrored onto Leap 15.6 by D108. The 2026-11-04 seed read the vendor_fix alone and labelled this build clean; the first truthset run (2026-11-09) found that label did not hold.
